# Data

## Load and set factor levels

Data are read from the archive and restricted to `included_in_analysis == TRUE`. 

```{r load}
setwd("C:/Users/xjw5/OneDrive - Northern Arizona University/NAU/Alaska - Leg C/Data/Legacy Carbon Collaborative")
dat_archive <- read.csv("LCC_LegacyCarbon_archive.csv")
dat_raw     <- dat_archive %>% filter(included_in_analysis == TRUE)

STUDY_AREA_LEVELS <- c("AK tundra", "AK boreal", "AK maritime",
                       "Yukon", "NWT", "Quebec", "NL", "Sweden")

ECO_LEVELS <- c(
  "Scandinavian Pine", "Western NA Mixed/Deciduous", "Maritime NA Spruce",
  "Western NA Upland Spruce", "Eastern NA Upland Spruce",
  "Western NA Lowland Spruce", "Eastern NA Lowland Spruce", "Western NA Tundra"
)



dat_raw <- dat_raw %>%
  mutate(
    StudyArea       = factor(StudyArea, levels = STUDY_AREA_LEVELS),
    Eco             = factor(Eco,       levels = ECO_LEVELS),
    ForestGroup     = factor(ForestGroup, levels = c("Black spruce", "Other conifer",
                                                     "Deciduous/Mixed", "Tundra / Non-forested")),
    Moisture_Class  = factor(Moisture_Class,
                             levels = c("xeric", "subxeric", "submesic",
                                        "mesic", "mesic-subhygric", "subhygric"),
                             ordered = TRUE),
    Moisture_3      = factor(Moisture_3,      levels = c("dry", "moist", "wet")),
    AgeClass        = factor(AgeClass,        levels = c("Short (<30 yr)", "Mid (30-70 yr)", "Long (>70 yr)")),
    BurnDepth_Class = factor(BurnDepth_Class, levels = c("Shallow (<5 cm)", "Moderate (5-10 cm)", "Deep (>10 cm)"))
  )
```

## Analysis datasets

```{r analysis-datasets}
# Primary dataset: all sites with complete C data
dat_all <- dat_raw %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(StudyArea), !is.na(ForestGroup),
    !is.na(prefire_total_C), prefire_total_C > 0,
    !is.na(prefire_legacy_C), !is.na(comb_total_C), !is.na(comb_legacy_C)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    StudyArea   = droplevels(StudyArea),
    ForestGroup = droplevels(ForestGroup),
    # Fire-free interval class (point shapes in Figure 4)
    FFI = factor(if_else(stand_age < 100, "<100 yr", "\u2265100 yr"),
                 levels = c("<100 yr", "\u2265100 yr"))
  )

# Ecosystems excluded from specific models because the response has no variation
ECO_NO_LC_COMB <- dat_all %>% group_by(Eco) %>%
  summarise(any_comb = any(comb_legacy_C > 0, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  filter(!any_comb) %>% pull(Eco) %>% as.character()

ECO_ALL_LC_PRESENT <- dat_all %>% group_by(Eco) %>%
  summarise(all_pres = all(LC_resid_bin == 1, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  filter(all_pres) %>% pull(Eco) %>% as.character()

# Subsets used repeatedly
dat_all_sites <- dat_all       %>% filter(!is.na(Eco))
dat_lc_sites  <- dat_all_sites %>% filter(LC_resid     == TRUE)   # prefire legacy C present
dat_lc_comb   <- dat_all_sites %>% filter(LC_combusted == TRUE)   # legacy C combusted
```

# Shared helpers

```{r helpers}
# ── Utilities ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
safe_div <- function(num, den)
  ifelse(is.finite(num) & is.finite(den) & den != 0, num / den, NA_real_)

se <- function(x) { x <- x[is.finite(x)]; sd(x) / sqrt(length(x)) }

# ── Themes ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
theme_pub <- function(base_size = 11) {
  theme_classic(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      axis.line        = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.4),
      axis.ticks       = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.3),
      axis.text        = element_text(color = "black", size = base_size - 1),
      axis.title       = element_text(color = "black", size = base_size),
      legend.position  = "top",
      legend.key.size  = unit(0.4, "cm"),
      legend.text      = element_text(size = base_size - 2),
      legend.title     = element_text(size = base_size - 1, face = "bold"),
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold", size = base_size),
      plot.title       = element_blank(),
      panel.grid       = element_blank()
    )
}

theme_lcc <- function(...) {
  theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.text.x     = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 11),
          axis.text.y     = element_text(size = 11),
          axis.title      = element_text(size = 12),
          legend.position = "top",
          legend.title    = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
          legend.text     = element_text(size = 10),
          strip.text      = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12), ...)
}

# ── Legend extraction (works for any legend.position; cowplot::get_legend can
#    return an empty grob with ggplot2 >= 3.5) ─────────────────────────────────
get_legend_grob <- function(p) {
  gt    <- ggplotGrob(p)
  grobs <- gt$grobs[grepl("^guide-box", gt$layout$name)]
  grobs[!vapply(grobs, inherits, logical(1), "zeroGrob")][[1]]
}

# ── Model helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Compact-letter display from emmeans as a tidy data frame (mean column -> `estimate`)
get_cld <- function(mod, label = NULL, factor_name = "Eco", adjust = "tukey") {
  em     <- emmeans(mod, reformulate(factor_name), type = "response")
  cld_df <- as.data.frame(cld(em, Letters = letters, adjust = adjust)) %>%
    mutate(.group = str_trim(.group))
  mean_col <- intersect(names(cld_df), c("response", "rate", "prob", "emmean"))
  if (length(mean_col) == 1) cld_df <- rename(cld_df, estimate = all_of(mean_col))
  if (!is.null(label)) cld_df$response_var <- label
  cld_df
}

# Likelihood-ratio test of full vs null model
get_lrt <- function(full_mod, null_mod, label) {
  a <- anova(null_mod, full_mod, test = "Chisq")
  tibble(response_var = label,
         Chisq   = a$Chisq[2],
         df      = a$`Chi Df`[2],
         p_value = a$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2])
}

# Fixed-effect coefficient table with readable term names
extract_coefs <- function(model, model_name = "") {
  as.data.frame(summary(model)$coefficients$cond) %>%
    rownames_to_column("term") %>%
    mutate(
      model = model_name,
      term  = term %>%
        str_replace("scale\\(prefire_depth\\)",      "Prefire SOL depth (SD)") %>%
        str_replace("scale\\(log\\(stand_age\\)\\)", "Stand age, log (SD)") %>%
        str_replace("scale\\(stand_age\\)",          "Stand age (SD)") %>%
        str_replace("scale\\(burn_depth\\)",         "Burn depth (SD)") %>%
        str_replace_all(":",                         " \u00D7 ") %>%
        str_replace("\\(Intercept\\)",               "Intercept"),
      Estimate     = round(Estimate, 3),
      `Std. Error` = round(`Std. Error`, 3),
      `z value`    = round(`z value`, 2),
      `Pr(>|z|)`   = case_when(
        `Pr(>|z|)` < 0.001 ~ "<0.001",
        `Pr(>|z|)` < 0.05  ~ paste0(round(`Pr(>|z|)`, 3), " *"),
        TRUE               ~ as.character(round(`Pr(>|z|)`, 3))
      )
    ) %>%
    select(model, term, Estimate, `Std. Error`, `z value`, `Pr(>|z|)`)
}

# DHARMa residual plots, one tab per model (use in a chunk with results = "asis")
dharma_tabs <- function(models) {
  for (nm in names(models)) {
    cat("\n\n####", nm, "{-}\n\n")   # {-} keeps tab labels unnumbered
    plot(simulateResiduals(models[[nm]]))
    cat("\n\n")
  }
}

# ── Table formatters ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
DASH <- "\u2014"
fin  <- function(x) x[is.finite(x)]
fmt_mean_se <- function(x, digits = 1) {
  x <- fin(x); if (!length(x)) return(DASH)
  sprintf(paste0("%.", digits, "f \u00B1 %.", digits, "f"), mean(x), se(x))
}
fmt_range <- function(x, digits = 0) {
  x <- fin(x); if (!length(x)) return(DASH)
  sprintf(paste0("%.", digits, "f\u2013%.", digits, "f"), min(x), max(x))
}
fmt_counts <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]; if (!length(x)) return(DASH)
  tbl <- sort(table(x), decreasing = TRUE)
  paste(sprintf("%s (%d)", names(tbl), as.integer(tbl)), collapse = "\n")
}

# House style shared by all Word tables
style_ft <- function(ft) {
  ft %>%
    font(fontname = "Arial", part = "all") %>%
    fontsize(size = 9, part = "all") %>%
    border_remove() %>%
    hline_top(part = "header",    border = fp_border(width = 1.5)) %>%
    hline_bottom(part = "header", border = fp_border(width = 1)) %>%
    hline_bottom(part = "body",   border = fp_border(width = 1.5)) %>%
    padding(padding = 3, part = "all")
}

# ── Output helpers (no-ops when params$save_outputs is FALSE) ────────────────
save_fig <- function(plot, name, width, height, ext = c("pdf", "png")) {
  if (params$save_outputs)
    for (e in ext) ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, paste0(name, ".", e)), plot,
                          width = width, height = height, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  plot   # returned visibly so the figure prints in the knitted report
}
save_docx <- function(ft, name, title = NULL, footnote = NULL) {
  if (!params$save_outputs) return(invisible(NULL))
  doc <- read_docx()
  if (!is.null(title))    doc <- doc %>% body_add_par(title, style = "Normal") %>% body_add_par("")
  doc <- body_add_flextable(doc, ft)
  if (!is.null(footnote)) doc <- doc %>% body_add_par("") %>% body_add_par(footnote, style = "Normal")
  path <- file.path(tbl_dir, paste0(name, ".docx"))
  print(doc, target = path)
  message("Saved: ", normalizePath(path))
}
```

# Prevalence of legacy C

```{r prevalence}
prev <- dat_all %>%
  mutate(Eco = as.character(Eco)) %>%
  group_by(Eco) %>%
  summarise(n_total        = n(),
            n_LC_prefire   = sum(LC_prefire,   na.rm = TRUE),
            n_LC_combusted = sum(LC_combusted, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  bind_rows(summarise(., Eco = "All sites", across(where(is.numeric), sum))) %>%
  mutate(pct_LC_prefire   = 100 * n_LC_prefire   / n_total,
         pct_LC_combusted = 100 * n_LC_combusted / n_LC_prefire)

kable(prev, digits = 1,
      col.names = c("Ecosystem", "N", "N legacy C", "N legacy C combusted",
                    "% with legacy C", "% of legacy-C sites combusted")) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE) %>%
  row_spec(nrow(prev), bold = TRUE)
```

# Main figures

## Figure 1 — Stacked bar plots (broken y-axis)

```{r fig1-helpers}
x_blank <- theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank())
x_label <- theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 9,
                                            color = "black", lineheight = 0.85))

# One segment (upper or lower) of a broken-axis stacked bar panel
make_bar_layers <- function(sum_df, raw_df, bar_pal, grp_levels, short_labels,
                            y_min, y_max, y_label = "", x_theme = x_blank,
                            letter_leg = NULL, letter_tot = NULL, is_upper = FALSE) {
  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_rect(data = sum_df,
              aes(xmin = grp_num - 0.38, xmax = grp_num + 0.38,
                  ymin = leg_ymin, ymax = leg_ymax, fill = grp),
              alpha = 0.95, color = "black", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_rect(data = sum_df,
              aes(xmin = grp_num - 0.38, xmax = grp_num + 0.38,
                  ymin = new_ymin, ymax = new_ymax, fill = grp),
              alpha = 0.30, color = "black", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_jitter(data = raw_df,
                aes(x = grp_num, y = y_tot, color = grp),
                shape = 21, width = 0.07, height = 0, size = 1.8, alpha = 0.70,
                fill = "white", stroke = 0.5) +
    geom_errorbar(data = sum_df,
                  aes(x = grp_num, ymin = tot_mean - tot_se, ymax = tot_mean + tot_se),
                  width = 0.25, linewidth = 0.9, color = "black") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = bar_pal, guide = "none") +
    scale_color_manual(values = bar_pal, guide = "none") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq_along(grp_levels), labels = short_labels) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = comma, limits = c(y_min, y_max),
                       expand = expansion(mult = c(0, if (is_upper) 0.05 else 0)),
                       oob = scales::censor) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(y_min, y_max), clip = "off") +
    labs(x = "", y = y_label) +
    theme_lcc() + x_theme +
    theme(
      legend.position     = "none",
      axis.line.x.top     = if (is_upper) element_line() else element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x.top    = element_blank(),
      axis.line.x.bottom  = if (is_upper) element_blank() else element_line(),
      axis.ticks.x.bottom = if (is_upper) element_blank() else element_line(),
      plot.background     = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      plot.margin         = if (is_upper) margin(0, 5, -5, 5) else margin(-10, 5, 0, 5)
    )

  if (!is.null(letter_leg)) {
    lab_df <- filter(sum_df, leg_ymax >= y_min, leg_ymax <= y_max)
    if (nrow(lab_df)) p <- p + geom_text(data = lab_df, aes(x = grp_num, y = leg_ymax, label = letter_leg),
                                         vjust = -0.5, size = 3.5, fontface = "bold")
  }
  if (!is.null(letter_tot)) {
    lab_df <- filter(sum_df, tot_mean + tot_se >= y_min, tot_mean + tot_se <= y_max)
    if (nrow(lab_df)) p <- p + geom_text(data = lab_df, aes(x = grp_num, y = tot_mean + tot_se, label = letter_tot),
                                         vjust = -0.5, size = 3.5, fontface = "italic", color = "grey30")
  }
  p
}

# Full broken-axis panel: summarise, build upper + lower segments, add break marks
make_broken_panel <- function(df, legacy_col, new_col, group = "Eco", y_label = "",
                              lower_max, upper_min, upper_lim, rel_heights = c(0.25, 1),
                              letter_leg = NULL, letter_tot = NULL, x_theme = x_blank) {
  df <- df %>% filter(!is.na(.data[[legacy_col]]), !is.na(.data[[new_col]]), !is.na(.data[[group]]))

  sum_df <- df %>%
    group_by(grp = droplevels(factor(.data[[group]]))) %>%
    summarise(leg_mean = mean(.data[[legacy_col]]), leg_se = se(.data[[legacy_col]]),
              new_mean = mean(.data[[new_col]]),    new_se = se(.data[[new_col]]),
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(grp_num  = as.numeric(grp),
           leg_ymin = 0,        leg_ymax = leg_mean,
           new_ymin = leg_mean, new_ymax = leg_mean + new_mean,
           tot_mean = leg_mean + new_mean,
           tot_se   = sqrt(leg_se^2 + new_se^2))
  if (!is.null(letter_leg)) sum_df$letter_leg <- letter_leg[as.character(sum_df$grp)]
  if (!is.null(letter_tot)) sum_df$letter_tot <- letter_tot[as.character(sum_df$grp)]

  grp_levels   <- levels(sum_df$grp)
  short_labels <- coalesce(unname(eco_label_short[grp_levels]), grp_levels)

  raw_df <- df %>%
    mutate(grp     = factor(.data[[group]], levels = grp_levels),
           grp_num = as.numeric(grp),
           y_tot   = .data[[legacy_col]] + .data[[new_col]])

  seg <- function(upper) make_bar_layers(
    sum_df, raw_df, PAL_ECO[grp_levels], grp_levels, short_labels,
    y_min   = if (upper) upper_min else 0,
    y_max   = if (upper) upper_lim else lower_max,
    y_label = if (upper) "" else y_label,
    x_theme = if (upper) x_blank else x_theme,
    letter_leg = letter_leg, letter_tot = letter_tot, is_upper = upper)

  stacked    <- plot_grid(seg(TRUE), seg(FALSE), ncol = 1, align = "v", axis = "lr",
                          rel_heights = rel_heights)
  lower_frac <- rel_heights[2] / sum(rel_heights)

  ggdraw(stacked) +
    draw_line(x = c(0.055, 0.075), y = lower_frac + c(0.012, -0.012), linewidth = 0.6) +
    draw_line(x = c(0.070, 0.090), y = lower_frac + c(0.012, -0.012), linewidth = 0.6)
}
```

```{r fig1, fig.width = 13, fig.height = 11}
                    y_label = "Prefire SOL C Interval (years)",
```

## Ecosystem-level models (Figure 2 & Extended Data Table 2 statistics)

Presence and combustion of legacy C by ecosystem (binomial GLMs), plus Gamma/Tweedie models of each pool and interval. Ecosystems with no variation in the response are dropped from the relevant model and shown as fixed points in Figure 2.

```{r eco-models}
# Presence: Tundra excluded (all sites have legacy C)
m_eco_pres <- glmmTMB(
  LC_resid_bin ~ Eco, family = binomial(link = "logit"),
  data = dat_all %>% filter(Eco != ECO_ALL_LC_PRESENT) %>% mutate(Eco = droplevels(Eco))
)
# Combustion | presence: ecosystems with no legacy C combustion excluded
m_eco_comb <- glmmTMB(
  LC_comb_bin ~ Eco, family = binomial(link = "logit"),
  data = dat_lc_sites %>% filter(!Eco %in% ECO_NO_LC_COMB) %>% mutate(Eco = droplevels(Eco))
)

cld_pres <- get_cld(m_eco_pres) %>% mutate(Eco = factor(Eco, levels = ECO_LEVELS))
cld_comb <- get_cld(m_eco_comb) %>% mutate(Eco = factor(Eco, levels = ECO_LEVELS))

# Pool / interval models: full (~ Eco) and null (~ 1) for each response
fit_eco_pair <- function(response, family, data) {
  list(full = glmmTMB(reformulate("Eco", response), family = family, data = data),
       null = glmmTMB(reformulate("1",   response), family = family, data = data))
}
gam_log <- Gamma(link = "log")
tw_log  <- tweedie(link = "log")
dat_comb_eco <- dat_all %>% filter(!Eco %in% ECO_NO_LC_COMB) %>% mutate(Eco = droplevels(Eco))

model_list <- list(
  "Total prefire C pool"     = fit_eco_pair("prefire_total_C",   gam_log, dat_all),
  "Total prefire C years"    = fit_eco_pair("prefire_total_yr",  gam_log, dat_all),
  "Total combusted C pool"   = fit_eco_pair("comb_total_C",      tw_log,  dat_all),
  "Total combusted C years"  = fit_eco_pair("comb_total_yr",     gam_log,  dat_all),
  "Legacy prefire C pool"    = fit_eco_pair("prefire_legacy_C",  tw_log,  dat_all),
  "Legacy prefire C years"   = fit_eco_pair("prefire_legacy_yr", tw_log,  dat_all),
  "Legacy combusted C pool"  = fit_eco_pair("comb_legacy_C",     tw_log,  dat_comb_eco),
  "Legacy combusted C years" = fit_eco_pair("comb_legacy_yr",    tw_log,  dat_comb_eco)
)

cld_all <- imap_dfr(model_list, ~ get_cld(.x$full, label = .y))
lrt_all <- imap_dfr(model_list, ~ get_lrt(.x$full, .x$null, .y)) %>%
  mutate(p_fmt = if_else(p_value < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(signif(p_value, 3))))

if (params$save_outputs) {
  write_csv(cld_all, file.path(tbl_dir, "cld_summary_table.csv"))
  write_csv(lrt_all, file.path(tbl_dir, "lrt_ecoregion_tests.csv"))
}

lrt_all %>%
  select(Response = response_var, `χ²` = Chisq, df, p = p_fmt) %>%
  kable(digits = 2, caption = "Likelihood-ratio tests: response ~ Eco vs. response ~ 1") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r fig3, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 7}
make_f3 <- function(x, y, size_var, xlab, ylab, title, interval = TRUE, shape_lc = FALSE) {

    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold")) +
        guides(fill  = guide_legend(ncol = 2, override.aes = list(size = 3, shape = 21), order = 1),
           size  = guide_legend(nrow = 1, override.aes = list(shape = 21), order = 2),
           shape = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3, fill = "grey70"), order = 3))

  if (interval) {

        scale_y_continuous(trans = tr_C, breaks = brk_C[brk_C <= yl[2]], labels = comma, limits = yl)
  }
}
```

## Drivers of legacy C occurrence and pool size (Figure 4 statistics)

For each response, all candidate models built from its two predictors are fit to the same profiles: the interaction model, the additive model, each predictor alone, and the intercept-only model. The final model is chosen by backward elimination on AIC, starting from the interaction model. A term is dropped when removing it raises AIC by less than `DAIC_DROP` (2 AIC units), meaning the data do not support keeping it. Main effects are only tested once their interaction has been dropped. The chosen models are used in Figure 4 and Extended Data Table 3.

```{r fig4-models}
DAIC_DROP <- 2   # drop a term if removing it raises AIC by less than this

# Response, its two candidate predictors, family and data (as in the original candidate set)
fig4_specs <- list(
  "Pr(legacy C present)" = list(
    y = "LC_resid_bin", a = "prefire_depth", b = "stand_age",
    family = binomial(link = "logit"), data = dat_all),
  "Prefire legacy C pool" = list(
    y = "prefire_legacy_C", a = "prefire_depth", b = "stand_age",
    family = tweedie(link = "log"), data = dat_lc_sites),
  # Conditional on legacy C being present
  "Pr(legacy C combusted)" = list(
    y = "LC_comb_bin", a = "log(stand_age)", b = "burn_depth",
    family = binomial(link = "logit"), data = dat_lc_sites),
  "Combusted legacy C pool" = list(
    y = "comb_legacy_C", a = "log(stand_age)", b = "burn_depth",
    family = tweedie(link = "log"), data = dat_lc_comb)
)

short_name <- c(prefire_depth = "depth", stand_age = "age",
                "log(stand_age)" = "log age", burn_depth = "burn")

# Complete-case data per response, so every candidate model uses the same profiles (AIC comparable)
fig4_data <- map(fig4_specs, function(s) {
  vars <- unique(c(s$y, all.vars(str2lang(s$a)), all.vars(str2lang(s$b))))
  s$data %>% filter(if_all(all_of(vars), ~ !is.na(.x)))
})

# The five candidate formulas per response
cand_formulas <- function(s) {
  A <- sprintf("scale(%s)", s$a); B <- sprintf("scale(%s)", s$b)
  nA <- short_name[[s$a]];        nB <- short_name[[s$b]]
  rhs <- setNames(c(paste(A, "*", B), paste(A, "+", B), A, B, "1"),
                  c(paste0(nA, " × ", nB), paste0(nA, " + ", nB), nA, nB, "null"))
  map(rhs, ~ as.formula(paste(s$y, "~", .x)))
}

cand_models <- imap(fig4_specs, function(s, resp) {
  d <- fig4_data[[resp]]
  map(cand_formulas(s), ~ glmmTMB(.x, family = s$family, data = d))
})

# Backward elimination: interaction -> additive -> single term -> null
backward_aic <- function(mods) {
  nm  <- names(mods); aic <- map_dbl(mods, AIC)
  cur <- nm[1]
  steps <- tibble(Step = character(), Comparison = character(), dAIC = numeric(), Decision = character())
  repeat {
    nxt <- switch(match(cur, nm), nm[2], nm[3:4], nm[5], nm[5], NULL)
    if (cur == nm[5] || is.null(nxt)) break
    d   <- aic[nxt] - aic[cur]               # AIC increase from dropping the term
    best <- nxt[which.min(d)]; d_best <- min(d)
    drop_it <- d_best < DAIC_DROP
    steps <- add_row(steps, Step = as.character(nrow(steps) + 1),
                     Comparison = paste(cur, "→", best), dAIC = d_best,
                     Decision = if (drop_it) "dropped (ΔAIC < 2)" else "kept (ΔAIC ≥ 2)")
    if (!drop_it) break
    cur <- best
    if (cur == nm[5]) break
  }
  list(selected = cur, steps = steps)
}

selection <- map(cand_models, backward_aic)

# Optional manual override, e.g. list("Pr(legacy C present)" = "depth + age")
FIG4_OVERRIDE <- list()
selected <- imap_chr(selection, ~ FIG4_OVERRIDE[[.y]] %||% .x$selected)

# Table: every candidate model, with the selected one marked
cand_table <- imap_dfr(cand_models, function(mods, resp) {
  aic <- map_dbl(mods, AIC)
  tibble(Response = resp, Model = names(mods),
         k = map_int(mods, ~ attr(logLik(.x), "df")),
         n = map_int(mods, nobs),
         AIC = aic, dAIC = aic - min(aic),
         weight = exp(-0.5 * (aic - min(aic))) / sum(exp(-0.5 * (aic - min(aic)))),
         Selected = if_else(names(mods) == selected[[resp]], "✓", ""))
})

cand_table %>%
  kable(digits = c(0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 1, 2, 0),
        caption = "Candidate models for Figure 4 (ΔAIC relative to the lowest-AIC model; weight = Akaike weight)") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE) %>%
  collapse_rows(columns = 1, valign = "top")

# Elimination steps
imap_dfr(selection, ~ mutate(.x$steps, Response = .y, .before = 1)) %>%
  kable(digits = 1, caption = "Backward elimination by AIC (ΔAIC = increase in AIC from dropping the term)") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE) %>%
  collapse_rows(columns = 1, valign = "top")

ft_sel <- cand_table %>%
  mutate(across(c(AIC, dAIC), ~ round(.x, 1)), weight = round(weight, 2)) %>%
  flextable() %>%
  set_header_labels(dAIC = "ΔAIC", weight = "Akaike weight") %>%
  merge_v(j = "Response") %>% valign(j = "Response", valign = "top") %>%
  bold(i = ~ Selected != "") %>%
  style_ft()
save_docx(ft_sel, "Supplementary_Table_Fig4_ModelSelection")

# Final models
mod_pres      <- cand_models[["Pr(legacy C present)"]][[selected[["Pr(legacy C present)"]]]]
mod_pool_pre  <- cand_models[["Prefire legacy C pool"]][[selected[["Prefire legacy C pool"]]]]
mod_comb_prob <- cand_models[["Pr(legacy C combusted)"]][[selected[["Pr(legacy C combusted)"]]]]
mod_pool_comb <- cand_models[["Combusted legacy C pool"]][[selected[["Combusted legacy C pool"]]]]

final_models <- list(
  "Pr(legacy C present) — binomial"   = mod_pres,
  "Prefire legacy C — Tweedie"        = mod_pool_pre,
  "Pr(legacy C combusted) — binomial" = mod_comb_prob,
  "Combusted legacy C — Tweedie"      = mod_pool_comb
)
cat("Selected models:\n"); print(selected)

coef_table <- imap_dfr(final_models, extract_coefs)
n_rows     <- table(factor(coef_table$model, levels = names(final_models)))
row_ends   <- cumsum(n_rows)

kt <- coef_table %>% select(-model) %>%
  kable(caption = "Final model coefficients. Predictors scaled (mean = 0, SD = 1).",
        align = c("l", "r", "r", "r", "r")) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"), font_size = 12, full_width = FALSE)
for (i in seq_along(n_rows))
  kt <- pack_rows(kt, names(n_rows)[i], row_ends[i] - n_rows[i] + 1, row_ends[i])
kt
```

## Figure 4 — Fitted relationships

Each panel plots its response against its usual predictor (a, b: prefire SOL depth; c: fire-free interval; d: burn depth). If the selected model dropped that predictor, the panel uses the predictor the model kept. If the selected model kept both predictors, predictions are drawn at three values of the second one. If it kept neither (null model), no fitted line is drawn.

```{r fig4, fig.width = 11, fig.height = 10}
# How each predictor is drawn
var_info <- list(
  prefire_depth = list(lab = "Prefire SOL depth (cm)",     grid = "[0:70 by=1]",  by = c(10, 40),  unit = "cm",
                       by_name = "Predicted prefire SOL depth", lim = c(0, 70)),
  stand_age     = list(lab = "Fire-free interval (years)", grid = "[1:260 by=1]", by = c(15, 100, 200), unit = "yr",
                       by_name = "Predicted stand age",         lim = NULL),
  burn_depth    = list(lab = "Burn depth (cm)",            grid = "[0:40 by=1]",  by = c(5, 15),   unit = "cm",
                       by_name = "Predicted burn depth",        lim = c(0, 30))
)

# Raw predictors kept in a model (log(stand_age) -> stand_age)
kept_vars <- function(mod) setdiff(all.vars(formula(mod)), all.vars(formula(mod))[1])

# Predictions for one panel: preferred x if kept, otherwise the kept one; lines by the other kept predictor
panel_preds <- function(mod, x_pref) {
  kv <- kept_vars(mod)
  x  <- if (x_pref %in% kv || length(kv) == 0) x_pref else kv[1]
  by <- setdiff(kv, x)
  if (length(kv) == 0) return(list(x = x, pred = NULL, by = NULL))
  terms <- paste(x, var_info[[x]]$grid)
  if (length(by)) terms <- c(terms, sprintf("%s [%s]", by, paste(var_info[[by]]$by, collapse = ",")))
  pr <- as.data.frame(ggpredict(mod, terms = terms))
  if (length(by)) {
    labs_by <- paste(var_info[[by]]$by, var_info[[by]]$unit)
    pr <- mutate(pr, group = factor(group, levels = var_info[[by]]$by, labels = labs_by))
  }
  list(x = x, pred = pr, by = if (length(by)) by else NULL)
}

make_response_panel <- function(raw_df, pp, y_var, y_lab, tag,
                                type = c("prob", "pool"), y_limits = NULL) {
  type   <- match.arg(type)
  x_var  <- pp$x; pred_df <- pp$pred
  by_var <- !is.null(pp$by)
  pos    <- if (type == "prob") position_jitter(width = 0.4, height = 0.02) else position_identity()

  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_point(data = raw_df,
               aes(x = .data[[x_var]], y = .data[[y_var]], fill = Eco, shape = FFI),
               color = "black", stroke = 0.4, size = 2.5, alpha = 0.75, position = pos)

  if (!is.null(pred_df)) {
    p <- if (by_var) {
      lt <- setNames(c("solid", "longdash", "dotted", "dotdash")[seq_along(levels(pred_df$group))],
                     levels(pred_df$group))
      p + geom_ribbon(data = pred_df, aes(x = x, ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high, group = group),
                      fill = "grey40", alpha = 0.15, color = NA) +
        geom_line(data = pred_df, aes(x = x, y = predicted, linetype = group),
                  color = "grey15", linewidth = 1.1) +
        scale_linetype_manual(values = lt, name = var_info[[pp$by]]$by_name)
    } else {
      p + geom_ribbon(data = pred_df, aes(x = x, ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high),
                      fill = "grey30", alpha = 0.18, color = NA) +
        geom_line(data = pred_df, aes(x = x, y = predicted), color = "grey20", linewidth = 1.1)
    }
  }

  p <- p +
    scale_fill_manual(values = PAL_ECO, name = NULL) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c("<100 yr" = 21, "\u2265100 yr" = 24), name = "Fire-free interval")

  # coord_cartesian zooms without dropping data, so CI ribbons are not truncated
  if (type == "prob") p <- p + scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(), limits = c(-0.05, 1.10))
  else                p <- p + coord_cartesian(ylim = y_limits)
  if (!is.null(var_info[[x_var]]$lim)) p <- p + scale_x_continuous(limits = var_info[[x_var]]$lim)

  p + labs(x = var_info[[x_var]]$lab, y = y_lab, tag = tag) +
    theme_pub() + theme(legend.position = "top", legend.text = element_text(size = 9))
}

pool_ylim <- range(dat_all$prefire_legacy_C, na.rm = TRUE)

fig4_preds <- list(
  panel_preds(mod_pres,      "prefire_depth"),
  panel_preds(mod_pool_pre,  "prefire_depth"),
  panel_preds(mod_comb_prob, "stand_age"),
  panel_preds(mod_pool_comb, "burn_depth")
)

fig4_panels <- list(
  make_response_panel(fig4_data[["Pr(legacy C present)"]],   fig4_preds[[1]],
                      "LC_resid_bin", "Pr(legacy C present)", "a", type = "prob"),
  # b, d: points show all sites; the fitted line is from the model on the subset
  make_response_panel(dat_all,                               fig4_preds[[2]],
                      "prefire_legacy_C", "Prefire legacy C pool", "b", type = "pool", y_limits = pool_ylim),
  make_response_panel(fig4_data[["Pr(legacy C combusted)"]], fig4_preds[[3]],
                      "LC_comb_bin", "Pr(legacy C combusted)", "c", type = "prob"),
  make_response_panel(dat_all,                               fig4_preds[[4]],
                      "comb_legacy_C", "Combusted legacy C pool", "d", type = "pool", y_limits = c(0, 10000))
)

# Shared legend below the panels:
#   row 1 = ecosystems
#   row 2 = fire-free interval symbols + predicted stand-age lines (from the first panel that has lines;
#           a and b use the same stand ages from var_info)
p_leg    <- fig4_panels[[1]]
has_lt   <- map_lgl(fig4_preds, ~ !is.null(.x$by))
p_leg_lt <- if (any(has_lt)) fig4_panels[[which(has_lt)[1]]] else p_leg

fig4_legend <- plot_grid(
  get_legend_grob(p_leg + guides(shape = "none", linetype = "none",
                                 fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 21, color = "black",
                                                                         size = 3, alpha = 1)))),
  get_legend_grob(p_leg_lt + guides(fill = "none",
                                    linetype = guide_legend(override.aes = list(linewidth = 0.8),
                                                            keywidth = unit(1.6, "cm"))) +
                    theme(legend.box = "horizontal")),
  ncol = 1
)

fig4 <- plot_grid(
  plot_grid(plotlist = map(fig4_panels, ~ .x + theme(legend.position = "none")),
            nrow = 2, align = "hv"),
  fig4_legend, ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(1, 0.14)
)
save_fig(fig4, "Fig4_model_fits", width = 11, height = 10)
```

## Extended Data Figure 3 — Depth of the legacy C boundary in the prefire SOL

The legacy C boundary is located by linear interpolation of calendar ages between the prefire surface (year of burn), the residual SOL surface (`calendar_year_median_TOP`) and the residual SOL base (`calendar_year_median_BOTTOM`). The threshold year is `Year_of_Burn − stand_age`.

```{r ed-fig3-data}
legacy_depth_dat <- dat_all_sites %>%
  mutate(
    legacy_threshold_year = Year_of_Burn - stand_age,
    residual_depth        = prefire_depth - burn_depth,
    # Residual surface and base ages. These equal TOP and BOTTOM for ordered
    # profiles; for retained inversions they are the youngest and oldest dates.
    resid_surface_year    = Year_of_Burn - comb_total_yr,
    resid_base_year       = Year_of_Burn - prefire_total_yr,

    legacy_boundary_zone = case_when(
      is.na(legacy_threshold_year) | is.na(resid_surface_year) |
        is.na(resid_base_year) | is.na(burn_depth) |
        is.na(prefire_depth)                                   ~ NA_character_,
      resid_base_year    >= legacy_threshold_year              ~ "No legacy C detected",
      resid_surface_year <  legacy_threshold_year              ~ "Combusted SOL",
      resid_base_year    <  legacy_threshold_year              ~ "Residual SOL"
    ),

    # Depth (cm from prefire surface) of the boundary
    legacy_boundary_depth_cm = case_when(
      legacy_boundary_zone == "Combusted SOL" ~
        burn_depth * safe_div(Year_of_Burn - legacy_threshold_year,
                              Year_of_Burn - resid_surface_year),
      legacy_boundary_zone == "Residual SOL" ~
        burn_depth + residual_depth * safe_div(resid_surface_year - legacy_threshold_year,
                                               resid_surface_year - resid_base_year)
    ),

    legacy_thickness_cm = case_when(
      legacy_boundary_zone == "No legacy C detected" ~ 0,
      !is.na(legacy_boundary_depth_cm)               ~ prefire_depth - legacy_boundary_depth_cm
    ),
    legacy_thickness_fraction              = safe_div(legacy_thickness_cm, prefire_depth),
    legacy_boundary_relative_to_surface_cm = legacy_boundary_depth_cm - burn_depth,

    legacy_depth_combusted_cm = case_when(
      legacy_boundary_zone == "Combusted SOL"                              ~ burn_depth - legacy_boundary_depth_cm,
      legacy_boundary_zone %in% c("Residual SOL", "No legacy C detected")  ~ 0
    ),
    legacy_depth_remaining_cm = case_when(
      legacy_boundary_zone == "Combusted SOL"        ~ residual_depth,
      legacy_boundary_zone == "Residual SOL"         ~ prefire_depth - legacy_boundary_depth_cm,
      legacy_boundary_zone == "No legacy C detected" ~ 0
    )
  )
```

```{r ed-fig3, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 10}
fig_dat <- legacy_depth_dat %>%
  filter(LC_prefire == TRUE, is.finite(legacy_boundary_depth_cm), legacy_boundary_depth_cm >= 0) %>%
  mutate(LC_comb_status = factor(LC_combusted, levels = c(FALSE, TRUE),
                                 labels = c("Legacy C retained", "Legacy C combusted")))

fig_dat_b <- filter(fig_dat, is.finite(burn_depth), burn_depth >= 0)
fig_dat_c <- filter(fig_dat, is.finite(stand_age),  stand_age  > 0)
max_b     <- ceiling(max(c(fig_dat_b$burn_depth, fig_dat_b$legacy_boundary_depth_cm)) / 5) * 5

y_boundary <- "Depth to legacy C boundary\nfrom prefire SOL surface (cm)"
eco_color  <- scale_color_manual(values = PAL_ECO, guide = "none")
comb_shape <- scale_shape_manual(
  values = c("Legacy C retained" = 1, "Legacy C combusted" = 17), name = NULL,
  guide  = guide_legend(override.aes = list(color = "black", alpha = 1, size = 3))
)

pA <- ggplot(fig_dat, aes(x = Eco, y = legacy_boundary_depth_cm, color = Eco)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.62, alpha = 0.12, linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.14, size = 1.8, alpha = 0.75) +
  eco_color +
  labs(x = NULL, y = y_boundary) +
  theme_pub() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 40, hjust = 1, vjust = 1))

pB <- ggplot(fig_dat_b, aes(x = burn_depth, y = legacy_boundary_depth_cm, color = Eco, shape = LC_comb_status)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5, color = "grey50") +
  geom_point(size = 2.4, alpha = 0.9) +
  eco_color + comb_shape +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, max_b), breaks = seq(0, max_b, 10), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.03))) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, max_b), breaks = seq(0, max_b, 10), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.03))) +
  labs(x = "Burn depth (cm)", y = y_boundary) +
  theme_pub()

pC <- ggplot(fig_dat_c, aes(x = stand_age, y = legacy_boundary_depth_cm, color = Eco, shape = LC_comb_status)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.4, alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 100, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5, color = "grey50") +
  eco_color + comb_shape +
  scale_x_log10(breaks = c(10, 30, 100, 300), labels = c("10", "30", "100", "300"),
                expand = expansion(mult = c(0.03, 0.05))) +
  labs(x = "Fire-free interval (yr)", y = y_boundary) +
  theme_pub()

ed_fig3 <- (pA / (pB | pC)) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a") +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1), guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.box = "horizontal",
        plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold"))

save_fig(ed_fig3, "EDFig3_legacy_boundary_depth", width = 12, height = 10)
```

## Extended Data Table 2 — Pools and intervals by ecosystem

```{r ed-table2}
# Mean ± SE, rounded to integers with thousands separators
fmt_int_mean_se <- function(x) {
  x <- fin(x); if (!length(x)) return(DASH)
  paste0(comma(round(mean(x))), " \u00B1", comma(round(se(x))))
}

# (min–max), rounded to integers with thousands separators
fmt_int_range <- function(x) {
  x <- fin(x); if (!length(x)) return("")
  paste0("(", comma(round(min(x))), "\u2013", comma(round(max(x))), ")")
}
# Row specification, in display order within each block
tbl2_spec <- tribble(
  ~site_group,                      ~row_label,                 ~var,                ~data,
  "All sites",                      "Prefire C pool",           "prefire_total_C",   "dat_all_sites",
  "All sites",                      "Prefire years",            "prefire_total_yr",  "dat_all_sites",
  "All sites",                      "Combusted C pool",         "comb_total_C",      "dat_all_sites",
  "All sites",                      "Combusted years",          "comb_total_yr",     "dat_all_sites",
  "Sites with legacy C",            "Prefire C pool",           "prefire_total_C",   "dat_lc_sites",
  "Sites with legacy C",            "Prefire legacy C pool",    "prefire_legacy_C",  "dat_lc_sites",
  "Sites with legacy C",            "Prefire legacy C years",   "prefire_legacy_yr", "dat_lc_sites",
  "Sites with legacy C",            "Combusted C pool",         "comb_total_C",      "dat_lc_sites",
  "Sites with legacy C",            "Combusted years",          "comb_total_yr",     "dat_lc_sites",
  "Sites with legacy C",            "Combusted legacy C pool",  "comb_legacy_C",     "dat_lc_sites",
  "Sites with legacy C",            "Combusted legacy C years", "comb_legacy_yr",    "dat_lc_sites",
  "Sites with legacy C combustion", "Combusted C pool",         "comb_total_C",      "dat_lc_comb",
  "Sites with legacy C combustion", "Combusted years",          "comb_total_yr",     "dat_lc_comb",
  "Sites with legacy C combustion", "Combusted legacy C pool",  "comb_legacy_C",     "dat_lc_comb",
  "Sites with legacy C combustion", "Combusted legacy C years", "comb_legacy_yr",    "dat_lc_comb"
)

long_all <- pmap_dfr(tbl2_spec, function(site_group, row_label, var, data) {
  get(data) %>%
    group_by(Eco) %>%
    summarise(value    = fmt_int_mean_se(.data[[var]]),
              range    = fmt_int_range(.data[[var]]),
              raw_mean = mean(.data[[var]], na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(site_group = site_group, row_label = row_label)
})

# Mean of ecosystem means (each ecosystem weighted equally)
WTD_COL <- "Ecosystem\nweighted mean"
wtd_all <- long_all %>%
  group_by(site_group, row_label) %>%
  summarise(w_mean = mean(raw_mean, na.rm = TRUE), w_se = se(raw_mean),
            w_min  = min(fin(raw_mean)), w_max = max(fin(raw_mean)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(!!WTD_COL := paste0(comma(round(w_mean)), " \u00B1", comma(round(w_se)),
                             "\n(", comma(round(w_min)), "\u2013", comma(round(w_max)), ")"))
# Tukey letters from the ecosystem-level models
letter_map <- tribble(
  ~response_var,               ~site_group,           ~row_label,
  "Total prefire C pool",      "All sites",           "Prefire C pool",
  "Total prefire C years",     "All sites",           "Prefire years",
  "Total combusted C pool",    "All sites",           "Combusted C pool",
  "Total combusted C years",   "All sites",           "Combusted years",
  "Legacy prefire C pool",     "Sites with legacy C", "Prefire legacy C pool",
  "Legacy prefire C years",    "Sites with legacy C", "Prefire legacy C years",
  "Legacy combusted C pool",   "Sites with legacy C", "Combusted legacy C pool",
  "Legacy combusted C years",  "Sites with legacy C", "Combusted legacy C years"
)
letters_df <- cld_all %>%
  inner_join(letter_map, by = "response_var") %>%
  transmute(Eco = factor(Eco, levels = ECO_LEVELS), site_group, row_label, letter = .group)

wide_all <- long_all %>%
  left_join(letters_df, by = c("Eco", "site_group", "row_label")) %>%
  mutate(value = paste0(value, coalesce(letter, ""),
                        if_else(range == "", "", paste0("\n", range)))) %>%
  select(site_group, row_label, Eco, value) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Eco, values_from = value) %>%
  left_join(select(wtd_all, site_group, row_label, all_of(WTD_COL)), by = c("site_group", "row_label"))

groups <- unique(tbl2_spec$site_group)
tbl2 <- map_dfr(groups, ~ bind_rows(tibble(row_label = .x),
                                    filter(wide_all, site_group == .x))) %>%
  select(row_label, any_of(ECO_LEVELS), all_of(WTD_COL)) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ replace_na(.x, "")))

header_rows <- which(tbl2$row_label %in% groups)
eco_cols    <- intersect(ECO_LEVELS, names(tbl2))

ft2 <- flextable(tbl2) %>%
  set_header_labels(values = as.list(setNames(c("", eco_header_short[eco_cols], WTD_COL), names(tbl2)))) %>%
  bold(part = "header") %>% align(align = "center", part = "header") %>%
  align(j = 1, align = "left", part = "body") %>%
  align(j = 2:ncol(tbl2), align = "center", part = "body") %>%
  bold(i = header_rows) %>% italic(i = header_rows) %>%
  style_ft() %>%
  hline(i = header_rows[-1] - 1, border = fp_border(width = 0.75, style = "dashed")) %>%
  width(j = 1, width = 1.8) %>% width(j = 2:ncol(tbl2), width = 0.85)

save_docx(ft2, "Extended_Data_Table_2")
```

```{r supp-helpers}
# Boxplot grid: one row per variable, one column per ecosystem, split by a TRUE/FALSE flag
make_flag_grid <- function(df, flag_col, vars, var_labels,
                           strip_x_size = 10, strip_y_size = 10) {
  df %>%
    select(Eco, flag = all_of(flag_col), all_of(vars)) %>%
    pivot_longer(all_of(vars), names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") %>%
    mutate(variable = factor(variable, levels = vars, labels = var_labels)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = flag, y = value, fill = Eco, alpha = flag)) +
    geom_boxplot(color = "black", outlier.shape = NA, linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = 0.15), size = 1.8,
               shape = 21, fill = "white", color = "black", stroke = 0.4,
               alpha = 1, show.legend = FALSE) +
    facet_grid2(variable ~ Eco, scales = "free", independent = "y", switch = "y",
                labeller = labeller(Eco = label_wrap_gen(12))) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = PAL_ECO, guide = "none") +
    scale_alpha_manual(values = c("TRUE" = 0.75, "FALSE" = 0.35), guide = "none") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_lcc() +
    theme(strip.background.x = element_blank(),
          strip.text.x       = element_text(size = strip_x_size, face = "bold", lineheight = 0.9),
          strip.background.y = element_blank(),
          strip.text.y.left  = element_text(size = strip_y_size, angle = 90),
          strip.placement    = "outside",
          axis.text.x        = element_text(size = 8),
          panel.spacing.x    = unit(0.3, "lines"))
}
```

## Supplementary Figure 2 — Proportion of legacy C pool and interval combusted

```{r supp-fig2, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 9}
dat_retain <- dat_lc_sites %>%
  filter(prefire_legacy_C > 0) %>%
  mutate(residual_legacy_C  = prefire_legacy_C  - comb_legacy_C,
         residual_legacy_yr = prefire_legacy_yr - comb_legacy_yr)

x_axis <- function(show) {
  if (show) theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  else      theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank())
}

prop_panel <- function(y_var, y_lab, show_x) {
  ggplot(dat_lc_sites %>% mutate(prop_C_comb  = comb_legacy_C  / prefire_legacy_C,
                                 prop_yr_comb = comb_legacy_yr / prefire_legacy_yr),
         aes(x = Eco, y = .data[[y_var]], color = Eco)) +
    geom_jitter(size = 3, width = 0.2) +
    geom_boxplot(aes(fill = Eco), alpha = 0.2, outlier.shape = NA) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = PAL_ECO, guide = "none") +
    scale_color_manual(values = PAL_ECO, guide = "none") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = y_lab) +
    theme_bw() + x_axis(show_x)
}

stack_panel <- function(resid_col, comb_col, y_lab, show_x) {
  eco_sum <- dat_retain %>%
    group_by(Eco) %>%
    summarise(Residual_mean  = mean(.data[[resid_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
              Residual_se    = se(.data[[resid_col]]),
              Combusted_mean = mean(.data[[comb_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
              Combusted_se   = se(.data[[comb_col]]),
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(Residual_ymax = Residual_mean, Combusted_ymax = Residual_mean + Combusted_mean)

  eco_long <- eco_sum %>%
    select(Eco, Residual = Residual_mean, Combusted = Combusted_mean) %>%
    pivot_longer(-Eco, names_to = "Component", values_to = "value") %>%
    mutate(Component = factor(Component, levels = c("Residual", "Combusted")))

  ggplot(eco_long, aes(x = Eco, y = value, fill = Eco, alpha = Component)) +
    geom_col(position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE), color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
    geom_errorbar(data = eco_sum, inherit.aes = FALSE, width = 0.2,
                  aes(x = Eco, ymin = Residual_ymax - Residual_se, ymax = Residual_ymax + Residual_se)) +
    geom_errorbar(data = eco_sum, inherit.aes = FALSE, width = 0.2,
                  aes(x = Eco, ymin = Combusted_ymax - Combusted_se, ymax = Combusted_ymax + Combusted_se)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = PAL_ECO, guide = "none") +
    scale_alpha_manual(values = c(Residual = 1, Combusted = 0.35)) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = y_lab) +
    theme_bw() + x_axis(show_x)
}

supp_fig2 <- (prop_panel("prop_C_comb", "Proportion of legacy C\npool combusted", FALSE) |
                stack_panel("residual_legacy_C", "comb_legacy_C",
                            paste0("Mean legacy C\npool (", UNIT_C, ")"), FALSE)) /
             (prop_panel("prop_yr_comb", "Proportion of legacy C\ninterval combusted", TRUE) |
                stack_panel("residual_legacy_yr", "comb_legacy_yr", "Mean legacy C\ninterval (yr)", TRUE)) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a") &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
        plot.tag.position = c(0, 1))

save_fig(supp_fig2, "SuppFig2_legacy_proportions", width = 12, height = 9)
```

## Supplementary Figure 4 — SOL C combustion calibration model

```{r supp-fig4, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 6}
# Calibration data: all archive profiles with field-measured combustion
# (matches the pipeline model, which is not restricted to included profiles)
cal_dat <- dat_archive %>%
  mutate(Moisture_3 = factor(Moisture_3, levels = c("dry", "moist", "wet")),
         Eco        = factor(Eco, levels = ECO_LEVELS)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(burn_depth), burn_depth > 0,
         !is.na(SOL.C.Combusted_final), SOL.C.Combusted_final > 0,
         !is.na(Moisture_3),
         SOL.C.Combusted_source == "field measured") %>%
  rename(SOL.C.Combusted = SOL.C.Combusted_final)

m_comb_cal <- glmmTMB(
  SOL.C.Combusted ~ burn_depth + I(burn_depth^2) + Moisture_3 + (1 | StudyArea),
  family = Gamma(link = "log"), data = cal_dat
)

# Panel a: marginal Nakagawa R2 (fixed effects only)
r2_nak  <- performance::r2_nakagawa(m_comb_cal)
r2_marg <- r2_nak$R2_marginal

# Panel b: squared correlation, study-specific vs model-estimated
cal_dat <- cal_dat %>% mutate(pred_model = predict(m_comb_cal, type = "response"))
r2_mod  <- cor(cal_dat$SOL.C.Combusted, cal_dat$pred_model, use = "complete.obs")^2

cat("Calibration model n =", nrow(cal_dat),
    "| marginal R2 =", round(r2_marg, 2),
    "| conditional R2 =", round(r2_nak$R2_conditional, 2),
    "| obs vs pred r2 =", round(r2_mod, 2), "\n")

pred_cal <- expand_grid(burn_depth = seq(0, 25, by = 0.5),
                        Moisture_3 = factor(c("dry", "moist", "wet"), levels = c("dry", "moist", "wet"))) %>%
  mutate(fit = predict(m_comb_cal, newdata = ., type = "response",
                       re.form = NA, allow.new.levels = TRUE))

unit_expr <- function(lab) bquote(.(lab) ~ "(g C" ~ m^{-2} * ")")

p_cal_model <- ggplot() +
  geom_jitter(data = cal_dat, aes(x = burn_depth, y = SOL.C.Combusted, color = Moisture_3),
              width = 0.2, size = 1.8, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_line(data = pred_cal, aes(x = burn_depth, y = fit, color = Moisture_3), linewidth = 1.1) +
     annotate("text", x = Inf, y = -Inf, hjust = 1.1, vjust = -0.5, size = 4,
           label = sprintf("Marginal R\u00B2 = %.2f", r2_marg)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = PAL_MOIST, name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +
  labs(tag = "a)", x = "Burn depth (cm)", y = unit_expr("SOL C combusted")) +
  theme_pub()

p_val <- ggplot(cal_dat, aes(x = SOL.C.Combusted, y = pred_model, fill = Eco)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.65, shape = 21) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = PAL_ECO, name = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = comma) + scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +
      annotate("text", x = Inf, y = -Inf, hjust = 1.1, vjust = -0.5, size = 4,
           label = sprintf("R\u00B2 = %.2f", r2_mod)) +
  labs(tag = "b)",
       x = unit_expr("Study-specific estimated SOL C combusted"),
       y = unit_expr("Model-estimated SOL C combusted")) +
  theme_pub() +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 3))

supp_fig4 <- plot_grid(p_cal_model, p_val, nrow = 1, align = "hv")
save_fig(supp_fig4, "SuppFig4_combustion_calibration", width = 12, height = 6)
```



## Supplementary Figure 5 — Radiocarbon content vs. assigned calendar year

Each dated sample in the analysed profiles, plotted at its assigned calendar year, against the atmospheric record: IntCal20 before 1950 and annual means of Hua et al. (2021) NH Zone 1 from 1950. Grey lines join samples from the same profile. Samples dated directly from the curve sit on it. 

```{r supp-fig5, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 12}
# One row per dated sample, from the profile archive (TOP / MID / BOTTOM columns)
plot_dat <- dat_all_sites %>%
  select(soilID, Eco,
         starts_with("calendar_year_median_"), starts_with("F14C_")) %>%
  pivot_longer(-c(soilID, Eco),
               names_to = c(".value", "position"),
               names_pattern = "(calendar_year_median|F14C)_(TOP|MID|BOTTOM)") %>%
  filter(!is.na(calendar_year_median), !is.na(F14C)) %>%
  mutate(Section = factor(position, levels = c("TOP", "MID", "BOTTOM"),
                          labels = c("Surface", "Subsurface", "Bottom")),
         Eco     = factor(Eco, levels = ECO_LEVELS))

# Reference curves in F14C: IntCal20 (pre-1950) + Hua 2021 NH Zone 1 annual means (1950 on)
intcal_env <- new.env()
load(system.file("data", "intcal20.rda", package = "Bchron"), envir = intcal_env)
curve_14c <- bind_rows(
  intcal_env$intcal20 %>% transmute(year = 1950 - V1, F14C = exp(-V2 / 8033)) %>% filter(year < 1950),
  as.data.frame(SoilR::Hua2021$NHZone1) %>% filter(Year >= 1950) %>%
    group_by(year = floor(Year) + 0.5) %>% summarise(F14C = mean(mean.F14C), .groups = "drop")
) %>% filter(year >= min(plot_dat$calendar_year_median) - 50)

# x axis: log of years before 2025, labelled as calendar years
yr_trans  <- trans_new("yr_log", function(x) -log10(2025 - x), function(x) 2025 - 10^(-x))
yr_breaks <- c(-3000, -1000, 0, 1000, 1500, 1800, 1900, 1950, 1980, 2000, 2015)

supp_fig6 <- ggplot(plot_dat, aes(calendar_year_median, F14C)) +
  geom_line(data = curve_14c, aes(year, F14C), inherit.aes = FALSE,
            colour = "grey55", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_line(aes(group = soilID), colour = "grey70", linewidth = 0.3, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = Section, shape = Section), size = 1.8, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_x_continuous(trans = yr_trans, breaks = yr_breaks, labels = yr_breaks) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(Surface = "#2a78d6", Subsurface = "#1baf7a", Bottom = "#eb6834")) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(Surface = 16, Subsurface = 15, Bottom = 17)) +
  facet_wrap(~ Eco, ncol = 2) +
  labs(x = "Assigned calendar year (CE; log scale of years before 2025)",
       y = expression(F^14*C), colour = NULL, shape = NULL) +
  theme_pub() +
  theme(legend.position = "top",
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        strip.text  = element_text(face = "bold"))

save_fig(supp_fig6, "SuppFig5_F14C_vs_year", width = 10, height = 12)
```

## Supplementary Figure 6 — Sensitivity to the legacy C age threshold

```{r supp-fig6, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 9}
legacy_thresholds <- c(10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 70, 80, 100, 150,
                       200, 300, 500, 1000, 2000, 5000, 10000)

# Legacy C = C older than (Year_of_Burn - threshold). Calendar ages are interpolated
# linearly through each profile, so the legacy fraction is a fraction of years.

# Prefire SOL: spans the prefire surface (Year_of_Burn) to the basal age (BOTTOM)
prefire_legacy_at <- function(df, th) {
  cutoff_year  <- df$Year_of_Burn - th
  # Basal age = Year_of_Burn - prefire_total_yr (= BOTTOM for ordered profiles,
  # = oldest date for retained inversions)
  legacy_years <- pmax(cutoff_year - (df$Year_of_Burn - df$prefire_total_yr), 0)
  legacy_frac  <- pmin(safe_div(legacy_years, df$prefire_total_yr), 1)
  df$prefire_total_C * legacy_frac
}

# Combusted SOL: sits ABOVE the residual surface, from TOP up to TOP + comb_total_yr
# (verified: reproduces the archive comb_legacy_C exactly at threshold = stand_age)
comb_legacy_at <- function(df, th) {
  cutoff_year <- df$Year_of_Burn - th
  # Residual surface = Year_of_Burn - comb_total_yr (= TOP for ordered profiles,
  # = youngest date for retained inversions)
  burn_start  <- df$Year_of_Burn - df$comb_total_yr
  burn_end    <- df$Year_of_Burn
  legacy_yrs  <- pmax(pmin(burn_end, cutoff_year) - burn_start, 0)
  safe_div(legacy_yrs, df$comb_total_yr) * df$SOL.C.Combusted_final
}

# Check: at threshold = stand_age these should reproduce the archive's legacy pools
recon_check <- tibble(
  pool      = c("Prefire legacy C", "Combusted legacy C"),
  r         = c(cor(prefire_legacy_at(dat_all_sites, dat_all_sites$stand_age),
                    dat_all_sites$prefire_legacy_C, use = "complete.obs"),
                cor(comb_legacy_at(dat_all_sites, dat_all_sites$stand_age),
                    dat_all_sites$comb_legacy_C, use = "complete.obs")),
  median_abs_diff = c(median(abs(prefire_legacy_at(dat_all_sites, dat_all_sites$stand_age) -
                                   dat_all_sites$prefire_legacy_C), na.rm = TRUE),
                      median(abs(comb_legacy_at(dat_all_sites, dat_all_sites$stand_age) -
                                   dat_all_sites$comb_legacy_C), na.rm = TRUE))
)
kable(recon_check, digits = 3,
      caption = "Reconstruction at threshold = stand age vs. archive values (expect r \u2248 1, diff \u2248 0)") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE)

CN_thresh <- bind_cols(
  dat_all_sites,
  map_dfc(legacy_thresholds, function(th) tibble(
    !!paste0("legacy_C_", th)                  := prefire_legacy_at(dat_all_sites, th),
    !!paste0("legacy_combustion_C_final_", th) := comb_legacy_at(dat_all_sites, th)
  ))
)

summ_by_threshold <- function(df, value_col) {
  df %>% group_by(Eco, threshold_years) %>%
    summarise(mean = mean(.data[[value_col]], na.rm = TRUE), se = se(.data[[value_col]]),
              .groups = "drop")
}

legacy_pool_long <- CN_thresh %>%
  select(Eco, soilID, prefire_total_C, starts_with("legacy_C_")) %>%
  pivot_longer(starts_with("legacy_C_"), names_to = "threshold_label", values_to = "legacy_C") %>%
  mutate(threshold_years = parse_number(threshold_label),
         prop            = safe_div(legacy_C, prefire_total_C))

legacy_comb_long <- CN_thresh %>%
  select(Eco, soilID, SOL.C.Combusted_final, starts_with("legacy_combustion_C_final_")) %>%
  pivot_longer(starts_with("legacy_combustion_C_final_"), names_to = "threshold_label", values_to = "legacy_C") %>%
  mutate(threshold_years = parse_number(threshold_label),
         prop            = safe_div(legacy_C, SOL.C.Combusted_final))

x_breaks <- c(10, 50, 100, 500, 1000, 5000, 10000)

make_thresh_panel <- function(data, y_lab, tag, is_prop = FALSE, title = NULL) {
  p <- ggplot(data, aes(x = threshold_years, y = mean, colour = Eco, fill = Eco, group = Eco)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = mean - se, ymax = mean + se), alpha = 0.15, colour = NA) +
    geom_line() + geom_point(size = 2) +
    scale_x_log10(breaks = x_breaks, labels = comma(x_breaks)) +
    (if (is_prop) scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), labels = percent_format())
     else         scale_y_continuous(labels = comma)) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = PAL_ECO, name = NULL) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = PAL_ECO, name = NULL) +
    labs(tag = tag, x = if (is.null(title)) "Fire-free interval (years)" else NULL, y = y_lab) +
    theme_pub() + theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  if (!is.null(title))
    p <- p + ggtitle(title) + theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0.5))
  p
}

pA_prop <- make_thresh_panel(summ_by_threshold(legacy_pool_long, "prop"),
                             "Proportion of SOL C that is legacy", "a", TRUE, "Prefire SOL C pool")
pB_prop <- make_thresh_panel(summ_by_threshold(legacy_comb_long, "prop"),
                             NULL, "b", TRUE, "Combusted SOL C")
pC_amt  <- make_thresh_panel(summ_by_threshold(legacy_pool_long, "legacy_C"),
                             unit_expr("Legacy prefire SOL C"), "c")
pD_amt  <- make_thresh_panel(summ_by_threshold(legacy_comb_long, "legacy_C"), NULL, "d")

thresh_legend <- get_legend_grob(
  pA_prop + theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
    guides(colour = guide_legend(nrow = 2), fill = guide_legend(nrow = 2))
)

supp_fig5 <- plot_grid(
  plot_grid(pA_prop, pB_prop, pC_amt, pD_amt, nrow = 2, align = "hv"),
  thresh_legend, ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(1, 0.12)
)
save_fig(supp_fig5, "SuppFig6_threshold_sensitivity", width = 12, height = 9)
```
